description: This file defines the class TableMenuBar, which constructs and manages the menu bar for a graphical user interface, specifically for a component related to table operations within the romraider project. It includes menus for file operations, editing, viewing, and comparison features, and manages various menu items and groups for user interactions.

classes.name: TableMenuBar
classes.description: This class extends JMenuBar and provides a customized menu bar for table-related operations within the application, including file, edit, view, and compare functionalities.

methods.name: initFileMenu
methods.description: Initializes the 'File' menu with options such as viewing a graph, comparing tables, and closing the current table.

methods.name: initEditMenu
methods.description: Sets up the 'Edit' menu with options like undo, revert, copy, paste, and interpolation tools.

methods.name: initViewMenu
methods.description: Creates the 'View' menu enabling access to table properties.

methods.name: initCompareMenu
methods.description: Configures the 'Compare' menu with options for displaying differences, comparing to other tables, and related display settings.

methods.name: applyTableTypeRules
methods.description: Applies specific rules based on the table type, such as disabling certain menu options for DTC tables.
